gloss: critical condition; on the verge of death

definitions.gloss: critical condition; on the verge of death
definitions.explanation: A medical state where a person's condition is extremely serious and death is imminent. Used specifically for life-threatening situations.

examples.japanese: ⟦{祖父|そふ}→祖父：01452_sofu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{危篤|きとく}だ。
examples.english: My grandfather is in critical condition.

examples.japanese: {危篤|きとく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{知|し}らせ→知らせ：03252_shirase⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}けて→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧⟦{病院|びょういん}→病院：00577_byouin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{駆|か}けつけた→駆けつける：14632_kaketsukeru⟧。
examples.english: Upon receiving the news of the critical condition, I rushed to the hospital.

examples.japanese: ⟦{患者|かんじゃ}→患者：00170_kanja⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{一時|いちじ}→一時：01799_ichiji⟧{危篤|きとく}⟦{状態|じょうたい}→状態：03345_joutai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{陥|おちい}った→陥る：14537_ochiiru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦その{後|ご}→その後：08501_sonogo⟧⟦{回復|かいふく}した→回復する：21330_kaifukusuru⟧。
examples.english: The patient fell into a critical condition at one point, but recovered afterward.

notes:
USAGE:
A serious medical term indicating imminent risk of death. When a family member is {危篤|きとく}, it is socially expected in Japan to rush to the hospital immediately, and employers are expected to grant emergency leave. Often used with ⟦{状態|じょうたい}→状態：03345_joutai⟧: {危篤|きとく}⟦{状態|じょうたい}→状態：03345_joutai⟧ (critical state).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {危篤|きとく}⟦{状態|じょうたい}→状態：03345_joutai⟧ (critical state)
- {危篤|きとく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{陥|おちい}る→陥る：14537_ochiiru⟧ (to fall into critical condition)
- {危篤|きとく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{知|し}らせ→知らせ：03252_shirase⟧ (news of someone being critically ill)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{重体|じゅうたい}→重体：01753_juutai⟧: serious condition — severe but not necessarily terminal
- ⟦{重篤|じゅうとく}→重篤：21643_juutoku⟧: grave condition — similar severity, more clinical
- ⟦{瀕死|ひんし}→瀕死：13429_hinshi⟧: on the verge of death — more dramatic/literary
